notes.title: Playtest live NOW! New character reveal!
notes.content:
[p]Hey there, I'm here with some big news: [/p][h2]The playtest for Resistance 204X is live now on Steam![/h2][p]
You can be among the first ones to [b]play the new character Sargon7[/b]. If you signed up beforehand, you can start playing right away after downloading the playtest. You can find the button to download the build on the [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1829140/Resistance_204X/"]Resistance 204X Steam page[/url]: [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42383592/9146d5fb6e862753d62a7c158435b865a706b1f3.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]The playtest will stay [b]live until the end of September[/b], so make sure to use your chance to get involved. After that we will take some time to look at your feedback and adjust Sargon7 before he gets implemented into the public demo. We look forward to hearing your thoughts![/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42383592/525f874aa7aeae1fd45955adc129ed674dd208c0.jpg"][/img][/p][p]If you want to participate and haven’t signed up yet, you can request access on Steam. [b]The sign-up will be open for 1 more week[/b].
If you stream your playing session, feel free to share it with the community on [url="https://discord.gg/kYxSgY5vCp"]our Discord server[/url]!
[/p][p][/p][p]
Have fun playing!
Lola
[/p]

notes.title: 📢 Amazing news for Resistance 204X! We finally…
notes.content:
We finally received funding to continue with the game development! A lot of you have been waiting patiently for any news so let me show you what to expect.

[h3][b]If you’re new here…[/b][/h3]
… or need me to refresh your memory: Resistance 204X is a fast-paced 2D fighting game that takes a twist on the traditional fighting game formula and puts it into a blending machine with Nidhogg and Footsies. Your objective: Fight strategically, disrupt your opponent with powerful combos and reach the other end of the stage. It’s easy to learn, but hard to master!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42383592/8bb6810f9a671da65ca4944b9bd6606c4c0be4ed.gif[/img]

[h3][b]What has been going on? Let’s quickly catch-up:[/b][/h3]
After quite a long time of solo-developing Resistance, Julio founded Yaga Studio in early 2024 together with Georg and Katharina! I, Lola, recently joined the team to help spread the word about Resistance. The team now consists of a multicultural mix of awesome people, who are excited to finally bring the vision for Resistance 204X to life, woo-hoo!

[h3][b]How to support the Resistance and stay up to date:[/b][/h3]

[b]Wishlist![/b]
Wishlisting the game is an easy and super helpful way to support the development. So if you haven’t done it already and are excited for the game, we appreciate your wishlist a ton!! <3

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1829140/Resistance_204X/

[b]Join the community![/b]
Hop over onto our [url=https://discord.gg/kYxSgY5vCp]Discord server[/url] to be the first one to get notified about exclusive playtests, teasers, updates, events & much more. Or simply connect with us and other players, give feedback and ask any burning questions!

[b]Play the demo![/b]
We are currently starting to work on adding and improving content for future demos, so we can hook you up with amazing new moves and characters. In the meantime you can check out our demo on Steam and leave a review, to let us know what you think!
(Keep in mind that the demo is currently only available in English. We are planning on translating the game in the future though!)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42383592/0ba7c98352e8ca56a954fbd3f26ab8f1b40db562.gif[/img]

[h3][b]Last but not least - a teaser on what’s coming:[/b][/h3]
We’ll give you more info about the changes and content that you’re gonna see in the coming months, but get ready for:
🤖 Many exciting new characters
💬 Storymode
🎮 Exclusive playtest opportunities
🙌 Online and on-site events
& of course thick vibes!! ✌️💥

That’s all for now! Spread the word, tell a friend and see you around!
Lola

notes.title: Resistance 204X Takes the Stage: Festivals, Highlights, and Awards in 2024
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42383592/a8a752ed11e3550013197ffda108e9e3e0823df6.png[/img]

2024 has been an exciting year for Resistance 204X, with both online and offline festival appearances! Here’s a recap of our journey so far:

[h1]Remote Play Together Fest[/h1] In February, we were thrilled to be selected by Steam for their Remote Play Together Fest. During this online festival, we streamed player reactions as they dove into the world of Resistance 204X and had a blast!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42383592/2ecbe644f945735ae17e4c65b891fe66acae09fd.png[/img]

[h1]GGBavaria[/h1] Also in February, we were honored to be featured at GGBavaria Fest 2024 in Munich, a hub for gaming enthusiasts, e-sports fans, indie game lovers, anime aficionados, and nerd culture in general. The energy was incredible, with cosplayers and attendees glued to our game. The feedback was so valuable that we immediately started making enhancements for our next showcase.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42383592/cefb2fea9f0ae889f72ddd5fa55d66eda73b64e8.png[/img]

[h1]CAGGTUS Indie Showcase[/h1] In April, Resistance 204X was selected by FusionPlay for the [url=https://www.caggtus.de/]CAGGTUS[/url] Indie Showcase in Leipzig, Germany. This was our opportunity to test the new enhancements we had been working on after GGBavaria, and it paid off! The response was fantastic, leading to our nomination for the [url=https://www.gamepro.de/artikel/find-your-next-game-indie-award,3411344.html]Find Your Next Game Indie Award[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42383592/8eb86ebf3d45e6c58c2b30388dd39ec1ba430325.png[/img]

We also pitched the game to a panel of experts and received incredible feedback, further refining our vision.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42383592/29d8594c5b2a461f6bb2b08a619dd492de88e699.png[/img]

[h1]Guadalindie Festival[/h1] In May, we took Resistance 204X to the Guadalindie Festival in Málaga, Spain. It was an unforgettable experience where we pitched the game to publishers and showcased it to a highly enthusiastic audience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42383592/0ba7c98352e8ca56a954fbd3f26ab8f1b40db562.gif[/img]

Our game was also featured on the [url=https://indiebandits.com/2024/06/03/the-best-indie-games-we-played-at-guadalindie-2024/]Best Indie Games at Guadalindie 2024[/url] list and mentioned in the [url=https://indiebandits.com/2024/06/03/the-best-indie-games-we-played-at-guadalindie-2024/]Indie Bandits Podcast[/url].

[h1]Beat Em Hub Indie Special[/h1] Later in May, we were selected to host a live tournament at [url=https://beatemhub.com/]Beat Em Hub’s[/url] Indie Special in Berlin, Germany. The Resistance 204X exclusive tournament was a highlight of the event, filled with intense, exciting matches that left participants and spectators alike buzzing with excitement.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42383592/aff42af79f3b674c967216ecf479f5e9a2f6d7b1.gif[/img]


[h1]Games Baked In Germany Steam Fest[/h1] In June, Resistance 204X was selected by the Verband der deutschen Games-Branche for the Games Baked In Germany Steam Fest, showcasing the best of German game development.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42383592/37f49211f286de6ece4a201efb38dbaa1962d17f.png[/img]

[h1]Steam’s Fighting Games Fest[/h1] And in July, we were once again featured by Steam, this time in their Fighting Games Fest, bringing even more players into the Resistance 204X community.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42383592/df1f2bd058535025e2c9225f76447a9eb8165439.png[/img]

We’re incredibly grateful for all the support and excited for what’s coming next. Stay tuned for more updates and join the resistance!

notes.title: Free Open Beta is now available!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=ZhdchZqSQN8;full][/previewyoutube]
Resistance 204X open beta is finally available and is packed with exciting features and updates!

[h1]New character: Slice[/h1]
First up, we've got a new big and strong playable character called "Slice". He's a force to be reckoned with, and you'll definitely want to try him out in battle. 

[h1]New terrains[/h1]
We've also added new terrains to the game, giving you even more options for your battles.

[h1]Twitch chat integration[/h1]
But wait, there's more! With our Twitch chat integration, Twitch viewers can mess with the streamer's game. Imagine the chaos that could ensue as the chat throws obstacles in the streamer's way or gives the opponent a sudden power boost.

[h1]Custom player names[/h1]
Finally, we're thrilled to announce that you can now add custom player names. This means you can truly make the game your own and show off your skills with your personalized username.

[h1]Join the Resistance[/h1]
Join the Resistance and take your fighting skills to the next level with Resistance 204X open beta. 

[b]Add to your wishlist[/b] and [b]Request access[/b] to get the free beta!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42383592/98391e55f5a636b4f6d62d54f7505f1d5c47b682.png[/img]
